messages:
alex_chan: Heads-up — Q3 launch spike modeling looks like 2.3x baseline for RLHF jobs and 3.1x for inference bursts. Need to nail a budgeted fallback plan for Dedicated pools (interruptible first, on-demand fallback)

maria_ops: Agreed. Can you summarize exact quota/limit asks so I can open cloud tickets? ENIs/EIP + GPU instance quota + regional headroom? :thinking_face: 

jonah_enginfra: Yep. Proposed ask: +150 A100 GPUs in us-west2 as interruptible, +60 guaranteed GPUs (reserved warm pool), ENI increase to 800, external IP quota +120, and a soft increase for autoscaler target to 1.8x per node group. I also want a cross-region fallback to us-central1 for critical flows.

sophie_capacity: Quick math: baseline avg concurrent GPUs = 120. For 3x burst we need ~360. With 60 reserved warm pool and 150 interruptible that's 210 headroom — still short. We should plan for on-demand fallback of ~150. Cost tradeoff looks acceptable for <6h/day peak.

alex_chan: Good point. So final request set: Reserved warm pool 60 A100, interruptible 200 A100, ondemand fallback 150 A100 in target regions (us-west2 primary, us-central1 fallback). ENIs 900, EIPs +150. Can someone draft the ticket text?

maria_ops: Drafted initial cloud ticket below, will attach workload profile and 7-day rolling percentile numbers. Pinged GCP with eval.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] quota-request-template.json created by maria_ops at 1925001300

jonah_enginfra: Paste the draft here for quick review before submitting to support: 
```
Hello GCP support — Redwood Inference requests quota increases for project redwood-prod:
- Compute: +350 A100 (split: 200 preemptible/us-west2, 150 on-demand across us-west2+us-central1)
- VPC: ENI quota -> 900
- VPC: Static external IP quota -> +150
We will use these for dedicated inference pools with autoscaler targets and a short warm pool for predictable latency. Peak pattern: 6–10am PT for 3–6h, weekday heavy. Please advise lead time and any placement constraints.
Ticket refs: internal plan doc: https://redwood.internal/capacity/q3-spike
Thanks,
Capacity/Infra team
```

sophie_capacity: Looks good. Add a sentence about preemption tolerance and fallback policy: "jobs tolerate preemption for non-latency-critical batches; we will route latency-critical requests to reserved ondemand pool or fallback region".

alex_chan: Also include request for ENI per-subnet adjustments — we hit ENI per-subnet limits last time. Add note: per-subnet ENI limit increase for nifi-subnet-usw2 and ml-subnet-usw2.

maria_ops: Updated and submitted ticket -> GCP#6789123. ETA from cloud-gcp-support: 3–5 business days for review, possible AZ placement constraints. :crossed_fingers:

cloud-gcp-support: Thanks for the details — we've opened the internal review (case 6789123). A couple questions: 1) Are you ok if some A100s are placed in a nearby zone in the same region? 2) For reserved capacity, do you have exact window and SLA (e.g., 99% availability 9–17 PT)? 3) Do you need project-level quota or folder-level?

jonah_enginfra: 1) Yes, zone flexibility is fine as long as we get inter-zone bandwidth guarantees. 2) Reserved warm pool: best-effort 95% during 6–12 PT for onboarding; if you need firm SLA we'll negotiate a commit. 3) Project-level is fine for now.

alex_chan: Also ask GCP to advise on preemption rates observed for A100 interruptible in us-west2 last quarter — helps pricing vs reliability calc.

maria_ops: Added those answers to the ticket at 1925001450. Also uploaded a short test plan: 24hr canary bringing 40 interruptible nodes live, run health checks and KV cache hit tests, then scale to 150.

infra-bot: [scheduler] canary-test window scheduled 2024-07-15T04:00Z by maria_ops :rocket:

jonah_enginfra: One more: we need an ENI fallback pattern for node churn — propose a staggered teardown policy (30s drain, 10m cooldown) and precreate spare ENIs to avoid slow attach path under scale. Add that to ops runbook.

sophie_capacity: I'll update the capacity runbook and send cost projection for preemptible vs on-demand for the three-week ramp. Expecting ~35% cost savings if preemptible works as modeled.

alex_chan: Great. Once cloud confirms quotas, we'll lock the warm pool and schedule the canary. Thanks all. :+1:"
